thread:
prasanna (acct-xyz): Hey team — our customer hits a 413 from the /rerank endpoint when they send a pretty normal query + docs bundle. They say it worked yesterday. Error: \"413 Payload Too Large: token/char limit exceeded\". Attached a snippet below.

prasanna (acct-xyz): Payload: query length ~1,800 chars; 220 docs, avg 1,200 chars each. They expected server to truncate or return clearer guidance.

maria (support): Thanks — can you paste the exact curl you used and the full error body (if any)? Also which SDK/version?

prasanna (acct-xyz): Sure — curl + truncated body (sensitive fields removed):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"query":"<long query: ~1800 chars>", "documents": [ {"id":"d1", "text":"<~1200 chars>"}, ... 220 docs ] }'
```
Error response: `\{\"error\":\"413 Payload Too Large\", \"detail\":\"token limit exceeded\"}`

maria (support): Got it. Can you confirm whether your docs are pre-tokenized or if you're sending raw text? Also which model param was used for scoring?

prasanna (acct-xyz): Raw text. They used model: rerank-lite-v1 (default), no explicit max_tokens param. Using node sdk 0.8.2.

jonathan (eng): Looping in eng. Quick hypothesis: rerank endpoint enforces a combined token ceiling = tokens(query) + sum(tokens(each doc preview)). For large doc counts we hit it fast. The error message currently just returns a generic 413 which confuses customers about whether it's per-doc or whole-payload.

jonathan (eng): Repro steps I ran locally: trimmed to 100 docs at same sizes -> success; 220 docs -> 413. So it's deterministic. I also checked server logs: request_size_tokens=~270k, limit=200k -> 413.

maria (support): Thanks. Customer asked for guidance on best fix paths — we should give pragmatic options they can try without re-architecting: 1) send document summaries/snippets instead of full docs 2) chunk docs and call rerank on batches (then merge top k client-side) 3) use our passage-level reranker if available 4) contact us for an account increase if they truly need huge doc counts.

prasanna (acct-xyz): They want an example of chunking + merge. Can you share a quick pseudo-code snippet?

jonathan (eng): Quick example (pseudo):
```js
// split docs into batches of N (e.g., 50)
for (batch of chunk(docs, 50)) {
  res = await client.rerank({ query, documents: batch })
  collect top M from res
}
merge_and_sort_collected_results();
```
Notes: keep M small (e.g., 5) per batch so final merge is tractable.

lisa (product): Also flagging UX: error detail should say something like: "combined token limit exceeded (allowed 200k) — reduce documents, shorten texts, or call in batches. See docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/rerank/limits". Current "token limit exceeded" is ambiguous. Can support attach a few customer quotes to the ticket?

maria (support): On it. prasanna — can you confirm whether the customer prefers a quick workaround vs wanting us to pursue a quota increase?

prasanna (acct-xyz): They're fine with workaround for now but asked if we can update error text so their devs won't waste time. Also asked if the SDK could detect large payloads client-side and warn.

jonathan (eng): Engineering notes: we can quickly (1–2 days) update server error payload to include numeric limits and a short actionable message. SDK-side: we can add a preflight token_estimate check in next minor release to warn if combined estimate > 80% limit. I'll open a PR.

maria (support): I'll respond to the customer with the workaround + timeline for server message fix and SDK warning. Draft reply: "Thanks — the 413 indicates you've hit a combined token ceiling. Short-term: chunk docs into batches (example attached). Medium-term: we'll update our error to include limits and add client warnings in the SDK." Want me to send?

prasanna (acct-xyz): Yes please. And pls include the curl snippet for chunking example.

deploy-bot: deploy v0.9.1 to prod succeeded (rerank service) :rocket:

jonathan (eng): Note — after deploy we should run a smoke test for a 220-doc payload to ensure error formatting changed as expected. I'll add a quick test to CI.

maria (support): Marking this thread for follow-up. I'll attach customer quote and set expectation: message UX change ETA 48–72h; SDK preflight ETA next minor (2 weeks).

prasanna (acct-xyz): Thanks all, they appreciated the quick triage. Closing on our side once we get the updated error message so they can resume dev flow. :pray:
